title: Case 06: Guided task — create a course (Vue 3)
titleZh: 案例06：引导任务创建课程（Vue 3）
summary: A realistic course page whose only job is creating a course. One sentence fills what it can infer, the assistant asks only for real gaps, long recommendations stay one-line previews, and the saved record is read back.
summaryZh: 一个真实的课程页面，只做“创建课程”这件事。一句话填写可推断的字段，助手只追问真正的缺口；长推荐保持单行预览，保存后回读课程列表。

guide.title: One page, one job, one reusable guide
guide.titleZh: 一页一件事，一套可复用的引导
intro: A Pling integration needs three things: declare the task fields, give the task a thin guide, and write values back into the existing form while an existing action saves. Step 1 below is the minimum path; the parser, custom guide, and read-back verification are upgrades, not prerequisites.

This example deliberately avoids a multi-module admin dashboard. The page is the original course form. It goes further than a minimum integration — one-sentence intake, precise field location, and read-back verification — so the code is larger on purpose.
introZh: 接入本身只有三件事：声明任务字段、给任务一个很薄的 guide、把值写回现有表单并交给已有动作保存。下面第 1 步就是最小路径；解析器、完整定制引导和回读校验都是增强项，不是前置条件。
这个示例刻意不混入多个后台模块。页面就是原来的创建课程表单；它额外做到了“一句话填写 + 精确定位 + 回读校验”，所以代码量高于最小接入。

steps.title: Minimum: register a task and its fields
steps.titleZh: 最小接入：注册任务与字段
steps.body: The minimum is one TaskDefinition (id, title, fields, save step), a thin guide (one step, a field rail, and the save action), and one registration. route, scope, and autoStart only decide when the task is available.
steps.bodyZh: 最小接入是一个 TaskDefinition（id、title、fields、保存步骤）、一个很薄的 guide（一个步骤、字段轨道、保存动作），再加一次注册。route、scope、autoStart 只决定任务何时可用。

steps.title: Add the goal and its boundaries
steps.body: objective, constraints, and successCriteria tell the assistant why the task exists, what it must not cross, and when it is genuinely done. A minimum integration can ship with fields only; these are the upgrades that make behaviour more reliable.
steps.bodyZh: objective、constraints、successCriteria 让助手理解为什么做、不能越过什么、何时算真正完成。最小接入可以只写 fields；这些是让行为更稳的增强项。

steps.title: Catch a whole description (optional)
steps.body: Deterministic intake is not a prerequisite. Without it, the model fills fields through pling_update_task and may take one extra round-trip. With it, common phrasings resolve locally, which is what this demo optimises for.
steps.bodyZh: 确定性解析不是接入前置条件。没有它，模型会通过 pling_update_task 逐字段补全，可能多一次模型往返；有它，常见说法可以本地命中，这是本示例专门优化的部分。

steps.title: Customise what the user sees (optional)
steps.titleZh: 自定义用户看到什么（可省略）
steps.body: A full custom guide is optional. The minimum guide is one step, a field rail, and a save action; business-specific summary rows and handoff copy are what this demo adds.
steps.bodyZh: 完整定制 guide 是可选的。最小 guide 只有一个步骤、字段轨道和保存动作；业务化的摘要行和人工接力文案才是本示例额外增加的。

steps.title: Write into the original controls
steps.body: Command handlers update the existing draft or mark the real field on the form. The chat never grows a second copy of the form; the original page remains the source of truth.
steps.bodyZh: 命令处理函数更新现有草稿，或在表单上标记真实字段。聊天里不会再长出一套表单，原页面始终是事实来源。

steps.title: Verify from the page, not from the promise
steps.titleZh: 从页面验证，而不是相信返回值
steps.body: After create_course runs, the page checks that the new record is first in the catalogue. Completion is based on that read-back, not merely on an action result.
steps.bodyZh: create_course 执行后，页面确认新记录已经位于课程库第一位。完成态依据这次回读，而不是只相信动作返回值。

guide.note: A minimum integration can stop after one TaskDefinition, a thin guide, and one pling.task.define. This demo adds local intake to save model round-trips and read-back verification to prove the write.
guide.noteZh: 最小接入可以只写一个 TaskDefinition、一个薄 guide 和一次 pling.task.define；本示例额外用本地解析减少模型往返，并用回读验证完成态。
